name: OvO
description: Makes WooCommerce stores shoppable by AI agents, programmatically. Audit, enrichment, merchant approval, and publish in place, on the merchant's own store.
agent: Meta Muse is the first supported agent.
rules: The merchant approves. An agent can click but never approve.
One scoped key per store. A key works for one store only.
A store is checked before it goes live in any listing.
